subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the bundled `cloudflare-ai-gateway-api-key` onboarding contract gain a backward-compatible Workers AI mode, or should Workers AI be supported only through the generic custom-provider onboarding path?
rationale: Both directions can solve setup, but the choice defines the permanent public CLI and generated-provider contract and determines how this work relates to the broader Cloudflare REST and multi-provider redesign.

options.title: Add Workers AI mode
options.body: Extend the Cloudflare plugin with an explicit endpoint mode and model selector while retaining the current Anthropic behavior for compatibility.

options.title: Document generic setup
options.body: Keep the bundled auth choice narrow and publish an exact non-interactive custom-provider workflow for Workers AI.

options.title: Fold into bridge redesign
options.body: Make the broader gateway bridge issue own onboarding and implement this only with its REST multi-provider design.

recommendation.title: Add Workers AI mode
recommendation.body: Extend the Cloudflare plugin with an explicit endpoint mode and model selector while retaining the current Anthropic behavior for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest feature-history routing candidate for the original Cloudflare onboarding surface and are already connected to this issue's discussion.
